source: ops/quota/allocations.json (owner-set, issue #1884) joined with ops/quota/registry.json entitlements and the public readings snapshot; entitlements are not usage and no focus attribution is invented.
cadence: Re-split at cadence ticks (dispatch-tree cadence / weekly sweep). Every change lands as a PR citing #1884 + the reason; this file is the single source lanes read.
constraints: Per pool, standing allocations sum to <= 100%; the remainder is explicit reserve (computed and published in the feed, never silently absorbed).
Card rule: no allocation authorizes a card-gated account, purchase or paid tier; pools are free tiers / documented entitlements / owner-supplied credit figures only.
Free-only: allocations spend documented free entitlement only; documented limits are entitlements, not balances.
No displacement: leftover-only focuses (incl. BOINC) draw only quota the higher-priority focus cannot consume before expiry, and never displace it.
BOINC eligibility: GitHub-provider surfaces only (owner rule); Codespaces is excluded for a TBD interim (owner, 2026-10-27).
Credit amounts are owner-supplied / registry-documented entitlement figures (joined from ops/quota/registry.json at feed build); never invented.
